## History

Magog is one of two large china dogs that sit on either side of the fireplace at Patty's Place. When [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends move into the cottage for their sophomore year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Magog and his counterpart, [Gog](../character/gog.md), serve as established decorative fixtures in the home.
